_comment: Golden fixture shared by src-tauri/tests/vault_file_ops_test.rs and src/tests/lib/features/collection/collection.service.test.ts. Each case is one note at `path` with `content`. `injected` is every key project_note_record (Rust) and buildNoteRecord (TS) add to, or rewrite in, the parsed frontmatter of `content`, with the projected value; a key injected on one side only fails that side's test. `record` lists final record values both sides must hold; it is used where the two parsers start from different values (null vs ""), so `injected` cannot compare them.

cases.name: quoted relationships and type
cases.content:
---
type: person
_belongs_to: "[[Team|the team]]"
_related_to:
  - "[[Bob#Intro]]"
  - "[[Carol]]"
_has_many: "[[Task one]]"
role: engineer
---

Body with #work tag.

unquoted wikilinks keep the source spelling of a YAML number or null
